regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler leads with 31" over the window, and its big day is Tuesday at 19". Expect rain for most of the week, with periods of rain Thursday and Friday nights. Cypress Mountain sees 1" by Saturday, mostly rain.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood tops the Tahoe group at 16", with 14" falling Friday. Sugar Bowl sees 15" and Palisades 15", both peaking Friday at 13". The forecast shows a chance of rain and snow Friday, with mixed precipitation likely Friday night.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Stowe leads the Northeast at 9", with 6" on Thursday. Whiteface sees 9" and Jay Peak 9", both also peaking Thursday. Wind is the main concern for Stowe early in the week, with gusts up to 32 mph Tuesday night.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth gets 9", all of it on Friday. Southwest winds are the main concern, with gusts as high as 60 mph Friday night. Snow chances continue through Saturday night, with gusts as high as 55 mph.

ahead.text: The Weather Prediction Center says a more organized storm may reach the West Coast and the Sierra around Sunday Nov 15, with heavier rain and high mountain snow. The Reno NWS office says confidence in its timing and amounts is low.
